desc:
♟️ Welcome to Chess Duels

Play fast, rated chess on Roblox against real people!

⚔️ PLAY: Bullet, Blitz and Rapid games, with ratings and a global leaderboard
🧩 PUZZLES: Solve more than 2000 puzzles to sharpen your tactics
📘 LEARN: Master lessons covering openings, tactics and checkmate patterns
🔍 REVIEW: Find your best moves or your blunders, with explanations
🎨 CUSTOMIZE: Spend coins on custom boards, piece sets, move trails, capture effects and avatar frames
🏆 PROGRESS: Level up, finish daily goals, keep your streak going and collect awards

Think you can reach the top of the leaderboard? Make your move! ♟️
